{{Top|leg}}
'''Jarlio''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of [[Athar]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[JanFathal]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he participated, along with the local rebels and the support of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]], in an uprising against the Republic-aligned [[Regent/Legends|Regent]].
